subject: Mystic Valley Parkway Rotary Redesign
overview: The commission addressed a "substandard" repainting of the Route 60 rotary by the DCR and coordinated staffing for several upcoming autumn community events. Members also voted to form a working group to replace a discontinued safety helmet program and requested the addition of cycling categories to the city's SeeClickFix system.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes for the meeting held on July 31, 2025.

items.title: Announcements
items.summary: Members discussed the opening of the Hills Hill pump track in Arlington, new bike lanes in West Medford, and a request to update the 2016 Bike Master Plan.

items.title: Bike Rack Procurement
items.summary: The commission discussed seeking a specific budget line item for bike racks and the challenges of coordinating installation costs with the Department of Public Works.

items.title: Police Working Group and SeeClickFix
items.summary: Voted to empower the chair to request that the city add categories for bike harassment and bike rack requests to the SeeClickFix reporting system.

items.title: Event Coordination
items.summary: Reviewed permitting and staffing for the October 26 Family Bike Ride, the October 18 Harvester Energy Festival, and the October 5 Tufts Community Day.

items.title: Website Maintenance
items.summary: Anna Rankert and Noam volunteered to assist with website updates and the creation of a recurring events calendar.

items.title: Safety Equipment and Helmet Working Group
items.summary: Voted to form a working group to research purchasing safety helmets and soliciting new corporate sponsors after the previous free distribution program was discontinued.

items.title: Clipper Ship Connector Wayfinding
items.summary: Members reviewed the installation of temporary plastic wayfinding signs in Medford Square and discussed the need for permanent crossing improvements during future state road projects.

items.title: Route 60 Rotary Repainting
items.summary: Voted to have the chair send a letter to the DCR protesting the lack of public comment and requesting sharrows to rectify "substandard" and dangerous new lane markings at the High Street rotaries.
